claim_scores.rationale: It patches `litellm.completion` and inspects `mock_completion.call_args.kwargs`, matching the chat path described in the evidence.
It sets `default_headers` in `dspy.LM(...)` and passes separate per-call `headers=...` on `lm(...)`, directly exercising constructor/request-time kwarg merging.
It prints and asserts that `call_kwargs["default_headers"]` remains exactly `{"X-Trace-ID": "trace-123"}` and is not merged into ordinary `headers`.
It asserts the runtime `Authorization` header is preserved and that `headers["User-Agent"]` was added, showing DSPy augments request headers with identification.
It explicitly asserts `"X-Trace-ID" not in call_kwargs["headers"]`, proving the tracing header from `default_headers` was not copied into request headers.
